recruiter.label: Recruiter
recruiter.intro: 6+ years designing complex products at Microsoft Azure, Jungle Scout, and Visier, now focused on Copilot and agentic experiences in the Azure portal. Outside work I own BPM end to end, a badminton club app I designed and built with AI agents, from strategy to store build.

workBlurb.Microsoft · Azure: Product designer on Azure's cloud infrastructure, designing Copilot for Azure experiences: an AI skill for cost management, an agent that guides data migration, and the design system they share. Led the design of the Storage Mover S3 redesign — one readiness model so users stop abandoning setup at hidden prerequisites, plus validation that never overstates what was actually checked.
workBlurb.Jungle Scout: Owned Advertising Analytics end-to-end — the first net-new feature for the consumer product since 2021. Drove it from 6 discovery interviews and a 216-participant study to a shipped 3-tab analytics experience (Q1 2022).
workBlurb.Visier: Early-career foundation in enterprise people-analytics UX. Designed chart controls (Top-N, 'Others' handling) that kept high-cardinality data honest, and led a mobile-first careers-site redesign.

collaborator.label: Collaborator
collaborator.intro: I'm deep in AI-native design — Copilot work on Azure by day, and BPM, an app I build by directing AI coding agents, the rest of the time. I validate the real problem before designing, and keep stakeholders in the room the whole way.

workBlurb.Microsoft · Azure: I work close to the metal on Azure infrastructure — mapping the hidden decisions users make, prototyping Copilot-style guidance, and partnering tightly with PM and engineering. On Storage Mover I built one readiness model across every entry point instead of bolting S3 on as a special case.
workBlurb.Jungle Scout: On Advertising Analytics I ran the whole process: 6 interviews, a FigJam synthesis with my PM, and a 60-minute stakeholder workshop to align cross-functionally. I pushed to strip solution-first language from the brief so we validated the problem first.
workBlurb.Visier: My early-career craft foundation — fast iteration, close collaboration, and making system constraints visible so users get guided toward valid configurations instead of blocked by them.

client.label: Client
client.intro: I design complex systems that explain themselves — so your users finish what they start instead of failing silently. I focus on the moments where a product technically works but still lets people down: setup, validation, and trust.

workBlurb.Microsoft · Azure: I design enterprise migration and setup experiences that surface prerequisites early and stay honest about what's actually been verified — so 'the job ran' never gets mistaken for 'the data is safe.' The Storage Mover S3 redesign shows how that plays out in a real product.
workBlurb.Jungle Scout: I turn dense, intimidating data into decisions people can act on. For Amazon sellers, I shaped raw advertising metrics into a clear 3-tab analytics experience that answered the business questions they actually had.
workBlurb.Visier: I make complex, high-stakes data legible for non-analysts — designing controls and views that keep the numbers trustworthy and the next action obvious.
